When this says it is waiting: on a BlackBox with M-VAVE's V22 or V23 head, switch it off, hold HOME, the right footswitch and the knob's PUSH, switch it on and keep holding until the screen shows RECOVERY. A pedal already in the chip's USB boot state is taken as it is.
